title: Zesty Peruvian Sauerkraut Stew
description: A bright, slow‑cooked stew featuring fermented cabbage and quinoa, spiced with aji amarillo and finished with fresh cilantro, served in a traditional Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the aji amarillo paste and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the sauerkraut and diced bell pepper, then cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the diced tomato, kale, and quinoa to the pot, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let the stew simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After 45 minutes, add lime juice and salt to taste, then stir well.
Remove the pot from heat and let the stew rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the stew hot in a Korean brass bowl, garnished with fresh cilantro.
Enjoy the zesty flavors of this slow‑cooked Peruvian dish.
